item.title: Star Trek: Voyager Officially Revisits the Series' Best Two-Parter in a Brand-New Way
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.category: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
item.description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown strategy game officially reveals Year of Hell DLC
item.content:encoded: One of the best two-episode arcs inStar Trek: Voyager, if not the entire Star Trek franchise, is the "Year of Hell" duology. The story from the show's fourth season pitted the crew of Voyager against a unique threat that tested their perseverance more than any previous enemy had.

item.title: GTA: Boston Would Go Wicked Hard, Kid
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a perfect Florida satire, and now I'm dying to see Rockstar's take on Massachusetts.
item.content:encoded: Considering that Grand Theft Auto 6 just launched after a 13-year wait, it’s safe to say that we won’t be getting another one any time soon. That’s fine, because Leonida is so enormous that I know I’ll still be finding secrets in it years from now. And yet, I can’t help myself. I’m already wondering where the series could possibly go next. Allow me to offer one unsolicited idea: Massachusetts.

item.title: The Sims 4 Officially Makes 13 DLCs Free for a Limited Time
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: The Sims 4 is hosting a holiday giveaway that allows players to claim up to 13 free Maker Packs throughout the next eight weeks.
item.content:encoded: The Sims 4 has received a steady stream of contentsince it launched 12 years ago. However, 2026 has been particularly dry. The last major expansion, Royalty & Legacy, was released in February, and aside from kits, the game hasn't received much content this year. This may be because of the team's focus on Project Renee (which may be on hold) or because of internal matters related to Electronic Arts' private-equity buyout.

item.title: Sorry Jason And Lucia, These 5 GTA 6 Side Characters Steal Every Scene They're In
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: Jason and Lucia aren’t GTA 6's only great characters, as these 5 have really endeared themselves to Polygon’s writers
item.content:encoded: Although Jason and Lucia are the stars of Grand Theft Auto 6 and amazing characters in their own right, there are lots of side characters who steal the show whenever they show up. From folks critical to the main story path to weirdos you meet if you take the time to stop and chat with someone on the side of the road, GTA 6 constantly introduces wild, memorable characters almost every hour.

item.title: GTA 6 Developers Have Voted Against Unionization by 75% to 25%
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: Rockstar Games workers have rejected a union deal with the IWGB as Grand Theft Auto 6 breaks records
item.content:encoded: Rockstar Games' UK workforce has voted firmly against unionization the week after the studio's latest game, Grand Theft Auto 6, demolished sales records.

item.title: 20 Years Ago, The Sopranos PS2 Game Sank So GTA 6 Could Swim
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 would probably exist without The Sopranos: Road to Respect, but it's funny to imagine that it wouldn't.
item.content:encoded: Part of what makes Grand Theft Auto 6 feel like a major cultural moment is that there’s never been a game quite like it. There are plenty of open-world games that share a similar structure, but there’s very little in the way of big-budget sandbox crime simulators that balance rich storytelling with emergent chaos. If you want to play a game like GTA in 2026, your only real option is GTA.

item.title: Ridley Scott’s Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Being Removed From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: Ridley Scott's Alien leaves Netflix on Dec. 1. Here's why the 1979 sci-fi horror classic's restraint still makes it the best movie in the franchise.
item.content:encoded: Ridley Scott is one of those staple filmmakers. The 88-year-old English director has made countless noteworthy films, TV shows, and commercials over the course of his prolific career, dabbling in so many genres that it’s difficult to narrow down the parameters of his work. With the release of this year’s The Dog Stars, Scott has directed 31 feature films. They don’t all share the same characteristics, but broadly, his films are known for huge and immersive sets, battles on an epic scale, and big and heady concepts.

item.title: Capcom Is Officially Killing Its 'Jurassic World Meets Overwatch' Shooter
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: Exoprimal, the not-Dino Crisis multiplayer shooter, is officially shutting down in 2027, four years after is PlayStation, Xbox, and PC launch.
item.content:encoded: Four years after the game's launch, Capcom is officially shutting down Exoprimal, the company's 5v5 action game about a futuristic dinosaur crisis. Capcom announced Tuesday that service for Exoprimal will be discontinued in September 2027 — meaning that Exoprimal will no longer be playable — and that the game will no longer be sold starting in March 2027.

item.title: The 25 Best PS5 Games in 2026
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: What are the best PlayStation 5 games? From GTA 6 to Star Wars: Galactic Racer, here are our favorite games to play on the Sony PS5.
item.content:encoded: That aside, the PS5's library has grown to the extent that there's a lot to sort through, and new and old PS5 owners will be wondering what to play. So here’s our living list of the best video games we’ve played on the platform — influenced by the personal tastes of the Polygon team — to be updated as more games come out.

item.title: Fortnite Cracks Down on Pirate Shop Token Cheaters and Teammates
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: Epic Games is bringing cheaters to justice, as more and more players turn to illegitimate methods to get Fortnite's Pirate Shop Access token.
item.content:encoded: With just over a week before Fortnite Treasure Hunters comes to an end, desperation has set in, as players begin to lose hope of finding the Pirate Shop Access token. This is the most coveted item in Fortnite history because it grants up to 28 days of free Item Shop cosmetics.

item.title: Lego Announces New Set for Fan-Favorite Marvel Character
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Lego has revealed its first Marvel Rivals set starring fan-favorite character Jeff the Land Shark
item.content:encoded: Marvel Rivals, the Overwatch-like hero shooter from NetEase and Marvel Games, is just a couple of weeks away from its second anniversary. To celebrate, The Lego Group is releasing a new set based on the game's take on an iconic Marvel character. This will be the first-ever Marvel Rivals set, though plenty of Marvel sets already exist, and to mark the occasion, it will turn the beloved Jeff the Land Shark into a brick-built figure.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Running Into a Game-Breaking Bug
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: GTA 6 players are running into a game-breaking bug that makes it impossible to progress the story.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6’s Leonida is full of dangers: murderous wildlife, over-eager cops, unhinged backwoods drug dealers, terrible drivers, and much more. However, all these threats pale in comparison to a particularly deadly foe. GTA 6 has a game-breaking soft lock bug that makes it impossible to progress.

item.title: New 'GTA 6' Leak Is Great News For PC Gamers, But There's A Catch
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: A new leak gives PC players a sense of what to expect from Grand Theft Auto 6 with souped-up settings that aren't possible on PS5 Pro or Xbox
item.content:encoded: Much has been said about the differences between Grand Theft Auto 6on PlayStation 5 and Xbox, but how will Rockstar Games' open-world game fare on PC? An official port has yet to be announced, but a recent leak of the Xbox build of the game has kicked off a race to recompile the game and make it unofficially available on more platforms. As that work continues, yet another leak offers PC players some perspective on what might be possible in GTA 6 when the game isn't held down by console constraints.

item.title: Diablo 4 Officially Gets a Big Live-Service Change
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Diablo 4's 16th season will make a big change to the game’s usual update cadence, keeping much of season 15.
item.content:encoded: Like many games built around a live-service model, Diablo 4adds and removes a lot of content each season to keep players coming back as often as possible. However, the game’s next season will be a bit of a departure from that usual formula.

item.title: GTA 6-Like Partnership With Playstation Announced by Witcher Developer
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Witcher and Cyberpunk developer CD Projekt Red and PlayStation enter new marketing deal akin to GTA 6.
item.content:encoded: Expect to see a lot of "plays best on PlayStation" messaging when The Witcher 4finally gets released in 2028 (if it doesn't get delayed). Developer CD Projekt Red has announced that it has entered into a marketing deal with PlayStation that will be similar to what Sony struck with Rockstar for Grand Theft Auto 6.

item.title: 72 Years Later, Lord of the Rings Officially Reveals How Sauron Made the One Ring
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.category: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
item.description: The Rings of Power showrunner Patrick McKay and Sauron actor Charlie Vickers explain how Sauron forged the One Ring and what it cost him in season 3.
item.content:encoded: "A theme throughout the earlier seasons of this show is the idea that creation requires sacrifice," series co-creator Patrick McKay tells Polygon. "One of Sauron's challenges this season is that he needs to learn what that means. He needs to actually be willing to sacrifice something. But that also means that maybe there's a part of himself he can't get back after that."

item.title: GTA 6's Most Heartbreaking Scene Is Exactly Why You Had To Do All Those Chores
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 features an exhilarating and heartbreaking sequence to end its first chapter as Lucia and Jason start a life on the run.
item.content:encoded: Jason repairs the steps leading up to his and Lucia’s home, fixes a railing, buys groceries, orders flowers, paints the walls of their bedroom, and more to prepare for Lucia’s arrival from prison. All those chores might seem less thrilling than the opening hours you’d expect in a big-budget action game. But it turns out they set up a tragic heartbreak I simply did not see coming.

item.title: GTA 6's Staggering Sales Still Might Never Catch GTA 5
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 smashed records for an entertainment launch, but GTA 5's lifetime sales might still be tough to beat
item.content:encoded: Take-Two said that GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies during its pre-release period, and that through the end of launch day on Nov. 19, it had racked up $3.79 billion in revenue.

item.title: The Witcher 4 Will Be a GTA 6-Sized Leap Forward, CD Projekt Red Says
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: The Witcher 4 will be a generational leap forward, a la Grand Theft Auto 6, CD Projekt Red boss says.
item.content:encoded: We're living in a post-Grand Theft Auto 6 world now, meaning that almost every other game in development will inevitably be compared to Rockstar Games' new open-world crime drama. The developer behind two other big open-world brands, The Witcher and Cyberpunk, is now fielding questions about how its future games will stack up against GTA 6.

item.title: The One Thing to Know About Jason and Lucia Before You Play Too Much GTA 6
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 hides some key character details behind moments you'll only see when Jason and Lucia are together.
item.content:encoded: Even after clearing Grand Theft Auto 6’s long story, I keep finding myself drawn back to Leonida. That’s thanks in large part to Jason and Lucia, a pair of charismatic protagonists that I genuinely enjoy spending time with. While you can treat them as independent characters and take them out on solo adventures, GTA 6 shines brightest when you travel around Leonida as a pair. In fact, you’re bound to miss a whole lot if you aren’t letting Jason and Lucia enjoy a date from time to time.

item.title: GTA 6 Data Reveals Only 40% of Players Have Cleared Chapter 2
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 achievement data shows that only 40% of players have reached Chapter 3.
item.content:encoded: If your feed is full of clips and streams from people who’ve already gone deep into Grand Theft Auto 6, here’s some reassurance: most players aren’t as far along as you probably think.

item.title: 'Blade Runner 2099' Stars Reveal the Secret to Being "More Human than Human"
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: Michelle Yeoh tells Polygon she wanted her Blade Runner 2099 character to be 'like a scary serpent'
item.content:encoded: Blade Runner left it ambiguous whether Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford) was human or Replicant, while Blade Runner 2049 focused on K (Ryan Gosling), a Replicant hunting his own kind. Blade Runner 2099puts a new spin on that formula with Cora (Hunter Schafer), a human fugitive pretending to be a Replicant Blade Runner so she can steal evidence from their headquarters.

item.title: This GTA 6 Moment Is A Trolling Master Class From Rockstar
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: GTA 6 keep crashing at the same place, and they're blaming Rockstar Games for tricking them
item.content:encoded: Have you ever seen those classic Looney Tunes cartoons where the murderous Wile E. Coyote dashes after the infuriating Road Runner? Usually, a high-speed chase ends with an unexpected comic twist, such as a bundle of dynamite exploding at the wrong time. Perhaps the most famous gag from these iconic animated shorts is the one where the plotting Coyote is tricked into running headfirst into a canyon wall painted to look like the entry to a tunnel.

item.title: Bungie Officially Shows Off Marathon’s Most Exciting Update Feature
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: PlayStation’s extraction shooter, Marathon shows off Bishop shell coming in massive Symbiosis update
item.content:encoded: Marathon's big Symbiosis update has been teased for weeks, but now it's almost here. Developer Bungie is set to release the major overhaul of its extraction shooter on Dec. 8, bringing plenty of new features such as dedicated PvE. One of the biggest additions, however, is an entirely new shell (think of these as Marathon's character classes) called Bishop. Now Bungie has shared our best look at Bishop yet.

item.title: New Xbox Was Originally Planned to Ditch Paid Multiplayer
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: The new Xbox was reportedly originally planned as a device without subscription fees, but Microsoft is now reconsidering.
item.content:encoded: All signs point to the next generation of console hardware being historically expensive. With rising component costs, the PS5 and Xbox Series are going for hundreds more than they did when they launched in 2020. In that context, it’s frightening to imagine the price of an even more powerful system, with one estimate placing potential manufacturing costs between $1,200 and $1,800.

item.title: Nintendo Switch Online Adds Another GameCube Classic
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: Nintendo just added the 2001 jetski racer Wave Race: Blue Storm to the Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack library.
item.content:encoded: Nintendo Switch Online's expansive library of retro games is a treasure trove of nostalgic experiences, and it just got a little bit better. That's because the 2001 GameCube racing game Wave Race: Blue Storm has just been added to the Nintendo Switch Online Plus Expansion Pack library. With the chilly season fast approaching, it's the perfect excuse for a little tropical getaway from the comfort of your couch.

item.title: Canceled Mass Effect Addressed Squad Members’ Fates, Writer Reveals
item.dc:creator: Elijah Gonzalez
item.description: A writer on the canceled Mass Effect: Universe hinted at how the game would handle returning characters and Mass Effect 3's ending.
item.content:encoded: Following the cancellation of the fifth mainline Mass Effect game, Mass Effect: Universe, fans can't help but wonder what could have been. In a recent Reddit AMA, Universe writer Cat Valente answered questions about the sequel, including how it would have addressed squad mates’ fates and Mass Effect 3’s controversial endings. Valente is an award-winning sci-fi and fantasy author and a Mass Effect series veteran, having previously written the 2018 novel Mass Effect: Annihilation. She worked on Universe for three years.

item.title: GTA 6's Best Easter Egg Is a Classic Tom Cruise Crime-Thriller You Can Stream For Free
item.dc:creator: Corey Plante
item.description: A GTA 6 taxi encounter echoes Michael Mann’s Collateral, starring Tom Cruise and Jamie Foxx. Watch it free on Pluto TV or stream it on Paramount Plus.
item.content:encoded: One of Grand Theft Auto 6’s strangest random encounters occurs when you’re offering taxi services, and a man with a beard wearing a dark suit and sunglasses climbs into the backseat with a gun. This can happen if you’re playing as either Jason or Lucia, but both scenes play out the same way: The man wants you to run a red light, ignore phone calls, and drive him to Harborside Park in Vice Beach. He also sounds an awful lot like Tom Cruise, with a calm but forceful demeanor that seems almost sociopathic. Several clips of the sequence have already hit the internet, and to many people, it’s an obvious nod to Collateral, Michael Mann’s 2004 thriller about a hitman who takes a cab driver hostage.

item.title: GTA 6 Is So Unstoppable It's Even Made Nickelback Go Viral
item.dc:creator: Ari Notis
item.description: GTA 6 features a radio station with alternate-language covers of pop songs, the best of which is the Greek Nickelback "How You Remind Me" cover.
item.content:encoded: It's still a debate whether Grand Theft Auto 6 has the best gaming soundtrack of 2026, but it certainly has the most soundtrack of 2026. Rockstar Games' latest open-world crime epic features more than 800 songs, most of which you'll hear on its 26 genre-themed radio stations. Of all this breadth of wild music, you'd figure the most popular song on the soundtrack would be something that had overlap with a Fast and Furious OST. But it turns out the single best song in the GTA 6 soundtrack is something by... Nickelback?

item.title: The 6 Most Outrageous GTA 6 Myths, Debunked
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has sparked a flurry of misinformation, as players keep sharing false details about Rockstar's new game.
item.content:encoded: After a wild opening weekend, Grand Theft Auto 6 is off to the races. Millions are playing Rockstar’s enormous open-world game and discovering its complexities in real time. There’s a lot to unpack in a game that’s filled with intersecting gameplay systems across a long story, and some players are already taking advantage of that. At the same time, the opening days of GTA 6’s launch have been filled with misinformation, much of it fueled by culture warriors and content creators looking to turn outrage into clicks on social media platforms that incentivize such behavior.

item.title: Legendary Critical Role Cast Members Officially Return With a Star-Studded New Guest Cast
item.dc:creator: Aimee Hart
item.description: A Critical Role cast reunion is on the horizon, with Travis Willingham and Aabria Iyengar returning for Campaign 4.
item.content:encoded: It’s hard to believe the entire Critical Role table for Campaign 4 hasn’t been together since the Convergence arc in June. Since then, the Soldiers, Seekers, and Schemers tables have remained separate. Or, more accurately, the Seekers and Schemers tables have remained separate.

item.title: Steam Officially Launches Its 2026 Game of the Year Awards Voting
item.dc:creator: Michael McWhertor
item.description: The Steam Awards nominations are now live, letting Steam users vote on the best games of 2026.
item.content:encoded: The Golden Joysticks has already weighed in on 2026's Game of the Year and The Game Awards has revealed its nominees for this year's best of the best. But one awards ceremony stands apart from the typical Game of the Year awards contest: the Steam Awards.

item.title: Goodbye, Mandy: GTA 6 Players Are Already Obsessed With Someone Else
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 fans were obsessed with Mandy in Chapter 1, and have now moved on to obsessing over Vicki in Chapter 2.
item.content:encoded: As Grand Theft Auto 6 began releasing around the world last week, players quickly became obsessed with Mandy. She's a neighbor of Jason's who tries to seduce the himbo while he fixes her sink. (And she is totally not a serial killer, no way, why would you ask?) Mandy shows up early in GTA 6. But as more players advance in the game, they're becoming obsessed with a new character: Vicki, a standout character from Chapter 2.

item.title: Steven Spielberg Officially Takes On a New Genre for Next Movie
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Steven Spielberg’s first Western, The Heart in Winter, has assembled a star-studded cast and is targeting a 2028 release.
item.content:encoded: Steven Spielberg is finally getting his chance to make a Western, and he's bringing some serious star power along for the ride. The legendary filmmaker is developing an adaptation of The Heart in Winter, with Jessie Buckley (Hamnet), Cillian Murphy (Oppenheimer), and Mark Rylance (Bridge of Spies) set to star.

item.title: GTA 6 Hacker Officially Walks Free After Judge's Final Warning
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the 2022 GTA 6 leak, walks free after sentencing, with restrictions on his online activity.
item.content:encoded: The man responsible for one of the biggest Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks is finally out of prison, and the judge had one very simple message for him: Don't do it again, mister.

item.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 ‘A Painted Symphony’ Officially Returns in 2027
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's acclaimed Painted Symphony concert series is getting a world tour in 2027
item.content:encoded: Following a sold-out European tour earlier this year, A Painted Symphony is coming back in 2027 with even more dates and locations. The concert series forClair Obscur: Expedition 33 will get an encore performance next year with a global tour including the first ever performances in North America. The world tour was announced today with tickets going on sale Sept. 15. It will include Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Fans in Asia, Africa, Australia, and South America are out of luck this time around.

item.title: Sorry, Vice City, but You’re the Most Boring Part of GTA 6
item.dc:creator: Giovanni Colantonio
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6's map is so well-designed that Vice City just might be the least exciting thing about Leonida.
item.content:encoded: When Grand Theft Auto 6 was first announced, fans were thrilled at the prospect of returning to Vice City. The Miami-inspired location has always been one of the series’ most memorable locations, its neon-lit streets standing in contrast to the grittiness of Liberty City. While I was as excited as anyone to go clubbing and spend some time on the beach, after 70 hours, GTA 6 has struck me with one surprise thought: Vice City is the least interesting part of Leonida.

item.title: GTA 6's T-shirts Are True Works of Art
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: Fashion can help you evade police in GTA 6, and Rockstar's design team has crafted some seriously covetable threads for the game.
item.content:encoded: We've known for some time that fashion would be a big deal in Grand Theft Auto 6. In Rockstar's official promotional materials for the game, both Jason and Lucia were prominently featured wearing stylish clothing, from Lucia's body-hugging gold dress to Jason's slick Miami Vice-inspired aqua sport coat. Even supporting characters like Brian wear Tommy Bahama-inspired aloha shirts yanked straight from the closet of a dapper middle-aged stoner. GTA 6 has drawn praise from all quarters for its scrupulous attention to detail in every aspect of the game, and there's one area the developer went far, far harder than it needed to: the vast and immaculate selection of T-shirts.

item.title: 'GTA 6' Bombshell: Husband Melts Down After Wife Hid Her Role In Game For Years
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: A long-kept GTA 6 secret low-key almost destroyed comedian Amber Wallin's marriage.
item.content:encoded: The gaming industry is notoriously secretive, and that's doubly true for anything related to Grand Theft Auto 6. Rockstar Games kept much of the game tightly under wraps, including one of the title's biggest secrets — a remarkable feat when you consider how much of the game leaked prior to launch. All of this might be true, but it didn't take the sting out of one husband's recent discovery about his wife's work on the record-breaking open-world title.

item.title: The Best GTA 6 Easter Eggs We’ve Seen So Far
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 features tons of celebrity cameos, pop-culture references, and nods to past Rockstar games. Here are a few of our faves.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally in the wild, and there are a mind-boggling number of things to do in Leonida. Many of them are terribly dangerous, like stealing cars from the police impound lot, getting into high-speed chases, and laundering stolen goods. But GTA 6 has plenty of wild and wacky optional activities too, many of which include references to pop-culture icons, past Rockstar games, or well-known memes. Here are a few of the coolest Easter eggs we've discovered in our own playthroughs and from other players on social media.

item.title: Six Years Too Late, Next-Gen Finally Arrives with GTA 6
item.dc:creator: Oli Welsh
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is the best reason to buy a PS5 or Xbox Series X, but it might be the last time a game makes us feel this way
item.content:encoded: Patch Notes is a weekly newsletter bringing you the best of Polygon, sent on Fridays and published on the site on Sundays. You can subscribe here.

item.title: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Built a 36-Foot Cyclops Puppet and Hauled It Up a Mountain
item.dc:creator: Terry Terrones
item.description: The Odyssey's effects team reveals how they built a 36-foot Cyclops puppet and hauled it up a mountain to film inside a cave in Greece.
item.content:encoded: The Odyssey’s special effects supervisor Scott Fisher and visual effects supervisor Andrew Jackson spoke with Polygon about creating Polyphemus, the one-eyed giant who traps Odysseus and his men inside his cave before the Greek hero devises a plan to escape. As it turns out, the production's biggest obstacle ultimately led to one of its most effective creative decisions.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Keep Discovering Ridiculous New Ways To Steal Money
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: GTA 6 players are discovering new creative solutions to get rich in Rockstar Games' latest open-world adventure.
item.content:encoded: Grand Theft Auto 6 is such a vast game full of incredible little details and ways to interact with its massive world. Days after its release, players are still finding new ways to steal and make money, including by ripping an ATM right out of the wall.

item.title: GTA 6 Makes It Nearly Impossible to Play Without Killing Anyone
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: I tried not to kill anyone in Grand Theft Auto 6 and failed. However, it changed the way I thought about and approached the game's violence.
item.content:encoded: Yeah, that didn’t last long. Turns out trying to not commit crime in the game that’s all about committing crime is a difficult task.

item.title: 8 Must-Play JRPGs for People With Real-Life Schedules
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Corgan
item.category: Dragon Quest 11: Echoes Of An Elusive Age
item.description: Busy schedule, long JRPG backlog? These eight games fit short sessions with chapter breaks, adjustable battles, and easy saves.
item.content:encoded: It’s 9:15 on a Wednesday night. The dishes are done. You have about 45 minutes before bed, and you’re a JRPG fan (or you were, when you had more time). JRPGs tend to demand dozens of hours from players — and they can make it very difficult to pause, as some of them will interrupt you with a battle every few steps.
